look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: find stiff, sharply angled green stems that appear almost leafless; inspect the nodes for clusters of tiny separate male or female flowers. Confirm minute alternate scale-like upper leaves and reddish fringed stipules rather than assuming the green shoots are grass blades.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Erect broomlike subshrub about 20–90 cm tall; stems rigid, smooth and angular, sometimes nearly leafless.

key_traits.label: Leaves attachment
key_traits.text: Leaves alternate and sessile when present; lower leaves small (about 5–15 mm), often toothed; upper leaves narrow or scale-like. Look at a stem node for reddish-brown fringed stipules.

key_traits.label: Flower reproductive
key_traits.text: Small flowers clustered at nodes, usually male and female on separate plants (dioecious). Male flowers have a 4–5-lobed calyx and 6–9 free stamens; female flowers have a 5-lobed calyx and short styles. Do not label sex of the photographed cluster without a closer verified view.

key_traits.label: Fruit seed
key_traits.text: Small 2–4 mm capsule; glossy dark ovoid seeds about 1.5–2.5 mm, with roughened surface.
